channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nick Young | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nick Young from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevon Looney on Nick Young
item.description:
Kevon Looney:

“Having Nick Young as a cousin has been awesome. I got to win a championship with him in Golden State. When I was a kid, he used to send me a bunch of shoes and clothes, so I used to be the freshest kid in high school and middle school because of Nick. Shout out to cuz, he made sure I always was good and being able to share the court with him was always great.”

Kevon Looney on Nick Young, Jul 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Nick Young
item.description:
“And so when you go look at our championship run that Nick Young was a part of, Nick Young was the swing player in the Houston series,”

Draymond Green on Nick Young, Nov 22, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Nick Young
item.description:
“In Games 6 and 7, Nick Young was one of the primary defenders on James Harden. Nick Young hit big threes. He swung the series for us. Guess what? Job done. When you talk about winning a championship, he swung the series. That's his job as a role player to swing one series. He did that.”

Draymond Green on Nick Young, Nov 22, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Nick Young, Patrick McCaw
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on backup SG battle between Young and McCaw:

“It hasn’t crystalized at all for me. I plan on using both guys all year long.”

Steve Kerr on Nick Young, Patrick McCaw, Oct 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Sean Marks on Nick Young
item.description:
“I think everybody's going to question what happened in the past with the whole Nick Young so forth,”

Sean Marks on Nick Young, Jun 26, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Nick Young
item.description:
Fred Katz:Billy Donovan on Young's game-winner:

“It looked like from the bench that Young certainly got a lot of steps in to get that shot off”

Billy Donovan on Nick Young, Nov 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Luke Walton on Nick Young
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Luke Walton on Nick Young:

“I don't think it's a shock and I do expect him to play this way night in and night out. He's our starting SG.”

Luke Walton on Nick Young, Nov 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @bgarcia90.

item.title: Luke Walton on Nick Young
item.description:
Serena Winters:Luke Walton on Nick Young solidifying a spot in the rotation:

“The way he's playing right now it's going to make decisions tough.”

Luke Walton on Nick Young, Oct 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Byron Scott on Nick Young
item.description:
Serena Winters:Byron Scott on Nick Young:

“Right now, he's not here with us, mentally, and there's no need for me to put him out here on the floor.”

Byron Scott on Nick Young, Apr 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Nick Young
item.description:
Pistons forward Marcus Morris said Thursday.

“You’re around them all year, and I’m pretty sure Nick Young knows some things about him that he’d never say. “At the end of the day, it’s unfortunate that it happened. I can’t even hope they fix it, because that’s one of them things that’s quite unforeseen for me personally.”

Marcus Morris on Nick Young, Apr 1, 2016. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Byron Scott on Nick Young
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Byron Scott on if Nick Young is in a slump:

“I guess you can call it that. He’s just not playing well right now.”

Byron Scott on Nick Young, Mar 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @Lakers_Examiner.

item.title: Larry Nance on Nick Young
item.description:
Larry Nance:

“For example,people don’t realize this, but Nick Young takes losses very hard. Seeing Nick, usually fun-loving and goofy, feeling down was tough. It was a clear sign about how much we had to pick it up as a team. But against the Bucks, he was rolling. Literally, barrel rolling on the floor.”

Larry Nance on Nick Young, Dec 22, 2015. Source: The Players' Tribune.

item.title: Byron Scott on Nick Young
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Byron Scott on Nick Young:

“He's a black guy. He wasn't even in the water. I don't believe that. He'd have gotten me better if he'd have said a shark. But a dolphin? Come on.”

Byron Scott on Nick Young, Feb 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Matt Bonner on Nick Young
item.description:
It still took Danklefs’ nationally-recognized skills to actually execute what could very well be the most unique shoes worn during the NBA’s five-game Christmas slate on Thursday.

“Nick Young is going to want a pair when he sees the swag I’m rocking,”

Matt Bonner on Nick Young, Dec 24, 2014. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Nick Young
item.description:
Mark Medina:Jeremy Lin on Nick Young:

“He's super cool, but I find it ridiculous everyone comes in and calls him Swaggy. He has to earn it!”

Jeremy Lin on Nick Young, Oct 3, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Jordan Farmar on Nick Young
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Jordan Farmar on his longtime rivalry with Nick Young:

“I told him, ‘It wouldn’t all be right in the world if we were on the same side.’”

Jordan Farmar on Nick Young, Oct 3, 2014. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Jordan Farmar on Nick Young
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Jordan Farmar on being teammates with Nick Young:

“We tried it for one season and the Lakers had the worst season in their history.”

Jordan Farmar on Nick Young, Oct 3, 2014. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Kendall Marshall on Nick Young
item.description:
Bill Oram:Kendall Marshall on Nick Young:

“He saves us a lot of times. We get to the end of the shot clock, ‘Where’s Nick?’ Give him the ball.”

Kendall Marshall on Nick Young, Jan 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @bill_oram.

item.title: LeBron James on Nick Young
item.description:
Brett Pollakoff:LeBron on Nick Young:

“We all know Nick. He makes one, he can make four or five in a row. He also can miss four or five in a row too.”

LeBron James on Nick Young, Dec 25, 2013. Source: Twitter @BrettEP.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Nick Young
item.description:
Mike Trudell:D'Antoni on Nick Young:

“He rubs off on me. He makes me happy. He starts ... swagging ... or something ... and it gets me going.”

Mike D'Antoni on Nick Young, Dec 21, 2013. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Nick Young
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Kupchak on Nick Young:

“Although it's a short contract, we hope he would be here for a very long time”

Mitch Kupchak on Nick Young, Jul 12, 2013. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Doug Collins on Nick Young
item.description:
John Mitchell:Doug Collins on Nick Young:

“My goal for him is to be the most improved player in the league next year.”

Doug Collins on Nick Young, Jul 17, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Andray Blatche on Nick Young
item.description:
Michael Lee:Andray Blatche on if he thinks Nick Young will return to #wizards:

“I mean, it’s 50-50.He’s got to do what’s best for him, in his life.”

Andray Blatche on Nick Young, Nov 30, 2011. Source: Twitter.
